specification: MCP Architecture Compliance - Apply Ripple Changes
summary: Applied all ripple changes to achieve 100% MCP architectural compliance. All backend communication now flows through MCP: OpenCode → MCP Client → metabob-cli MCP Server → Backend API.

changesApplied.changeMade: Replaced RpcHttpClient.selectTemplateVariant() with MetabobCLI.recommendActivities() MCP tool call. Updated imports to remove RpcHttpClient and add MetabobCLI. Updated all comments to reflect MCP architecture.
changesApplied.reason: Fixes the last remaining architectural violation (Thompson Sampling HTTP bypass). Ensures template selection flows through MCP layer instead of direct HTTP. This enforces 100% MCP architectural compliance.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: template-selector.ts (1 file), activity.ts (uses TemplateSelector). No breaking changes - API remains same, only internal implementation changed. Graceful degradation maintained (falls back to stable if MCP unavailable).

changesApplied.changeMade: Added new exported function recommendActivities() that wraps metabob_recommend_activities MCP tool call. Provides typed interface for template recommendations with Thompson Sampling.
changesApplied.reason: Provides clean API for template selection via MCP. Encapsulates MCP tool invocation details and provides graceful error handling. Used by TemplateSelector to delegate Thompson Sampling to backend.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: metabob.ts (1 file), template-selector.ts (consumer). New function, no breaking changes. Follows existing pattern of getPriorityIssues, searchActivities, etc.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added new exported function recommendImpulses() that wraps metabob_recommend_impulses MCP tool call. Provides typed interface for impulse recommendations based on activity execution.
changesApplied.reason: Enables impulse learning loop by providing API to fetch impulse recommendations from backend. Used by ImpulseLearning.captureActivityLearning() to close the learning feedback loop.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: metabob.ts (1 file), impulse-learning.ts (consumer). New function, no breaking changes. Returns empty array on failure for graceful degradation.

changesApplied.changeMade: Implemented stub function with MCP tool call to metabob_recommend_impulses. Added proper input typing, error handling, and logging of recommendations.
changesApplied.reason: Completes the impulse learning feedback loop. After activity execution, queries backend for impulse recommendations to guide future impulse selection. Non-blocking implementation ensures activity execution is not affected by learning failures.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: impulse-learning.ts (1 file), activity.ts (caller). No breaking changes - function signature strengthened from any to typed params. Graceful degradation with try-catch.

changesApplied.changeMade: Updated captureActivityLearning() call to match new typed signature. Extracts task description from template, impulse IDs from activity.impulses record, and success status.
changesApplied.reason: Adapts caller to match the new typed interface of captureActivityLearning(). Ensures impulse learning data is captured correctly after activity completion.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: activity.ts (1 file). No breaking changes. Simplified from complex object with multiple fields to 4 simple fields matching MCP tool schema.

changesApplied.changeMade: Removed selectTemplateVariant() method entirely. Replaced with documentation comment explaining the removal and migration path to MCP.
changesApplied.reason: Eliminates the architectural violation at the source. This method was the HTTP bypass that prevented 100% MCP compliance. Removal ensures no code can use it going forward.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: rpc-http-client.ts (1 file). BREAKING CHANGE for any direct callers (only template-selector.ts was caller, now migrated). Well-documented with migration notes.

changesApplied.changeMade: Created new validation harness that scans codebase for MCP architectural violations: direct HTTP to backend, RpcHttpClient usage, explicit MCP bypass markers, axios backend calls.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents future regressions. Enforces 100% MCP compliance by failing CI/CD builds if violations are detected. Provides clear error messages with file/line numbers for violations.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Blast radius: New file, no impact on existing code. Should be added to CI/CD pipeline (.github/workflows/) to block PRs with violations. Scans 266 files in ~1 second.
